purpose: Design exploration; not shipped gameplay assets

concepts.name: 01-living-mud-patch
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make a high-fidelity portrait iPhone screen concept for existing cozy game Tickle the Pig. Warm cream paper #fffaf0, dark cocoa ink outlines #2a1f15, sage leaves, rose pink, clay-brown mud, hard cut-paper shadows and hand-painted illustrated shading. Whimsical rounded Caprasimo-like display lettering and friendly Nunito labels. Rosie: very round baby pink pig, enormous shiny black eyes, rosy cheeks, large pale pink snout with dark nostrils, little triangular ears, short legs and dark cloven hooves, clean friendly ink contour. Great Hungerer: larger chubby pink pig in small gold crown and white bib, munching a heap of brown truffles, mischievous and sleepy. Real rules: rub or shove mud to uncover Golden Truffles, mysterious relics and shimmering Motes; keep everything fully uncovered when Hungerer stirs. One dig per Feeding. Minimal interface, generous touch targets, playable area dominant. No energy, purchased gems, meters, casino, emoji, realistic 3D, glass dashboard, square grid, thick phone hardware. Beautiful authored mobile game concept, not implementation proof.
Direction A: THE LIVING MUD PATCH. One 9:16 active digging screen. Small cream title tab "Truffle Patch" with back chevron. Quiet woodland, crowned Hungerer upper-background behind mossy roots. Main 65% of screen is a large organic oval of soft earth seen slightly from above; a CONTINUOUS tactile surface without tiles. A broad curved swipe has brushed mud into curled ridges and crumbs revealing a bright golden truffle cluster, half a brass key and a tiny blue-lilac glimmer. Root-and-clover frame, joyful soft clay layers. Rosie peeks from lower left, cloth collection pouch with three gold truffles lower right. Small label "3 finds". Beneath patch handwritten "Brush gently. Find something lovely." One simple rose paper "Pack up" button in bottom safe area. Crisp typography. Screen feels tactile, quiet and immediately playable.

Direction B: UNDER THE ROOTS. One 9:16 active digging screen; entirely different from top-down. A side-on UNDERGROUND CUTAWAY like a children's pop-up nature book. Cream title "Under the Roots", back chevron. Grass surface at upper quarter: Rosie sniffs left, crowned Hungerer eats in background right. Below, flowing cocoa/terracotta soil strata and curling roots fill 65% of screen. A broad thumb-sized excavation curves diagonally down through soil, revealing a Golden Truffle cluster in a hollow and part of an ornate relic farther down. No square blocks; organic removable layers. Displaced mud curls convey brushed-away action. Bottom cream paper, cloth pouch with three golden truffles, small "3 finds", handwritten "Keep what you uncover", rose button "Head home". Lots of playable room, clean silhouettes and delight. Warm illuminated deep-soil colors, no mining equipment. A substantive exploration of depth and discovery.

Direction C: FOLLOW YOUR SNOUT. One 9:16 active digging screen. A little ISOMETRIC woodland glade diorama, five broad soft-earth mounds along a natural curved path between clover and roots. Large clean touchable silhouettes and negative space. Rosie stands IN the glade sniffing closest mound; pale hand-drawn scent curls lead from nose to its half-revealed Golden Truffle. Two mounds behind her are already excavated and empty, last two undisturbed and mysterious. Cloth pouch of unearthed truffles beside path. Crowned Hungerer lounging against stump far upstage. No map-node circles or route lines; the land itself invites play. Cream-paper title "Follow Your Snout", discreet back chevron. Handwritten "Sniff a spot. Brush it open." Rose paper bottom button "Take your finds home". Choice and character animation distinguish this direction from a scratch ticket. Cozy morning light, moss and rose accents, warm ink contours, no generic dashboard.
